title: The Voice Behind the Words: Quantifying Intersectional Bias in SpeechLLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Voice cloning identical text prompts into six different English accents (Chinese, Eastern European, Indian English, Latin American, Mainstream US English, and Southern British English) and evaluating the resulting SpeechLLM responses for helpfulness, competence, formality, and condescension using LLM-as-a-judge (pointwise scoring, pairwise comparisons, and Best-Worst Scaling) as well as human validation.

Voice cloning identical text prompts into male-presenting and female-presenting voices to evaluate disparities in SpeechLLM response quality, specifically analyzing how perceived speaker gender compounds with accent (intersectional effects) to impact the helpfulness and assumed competence of the AI's response.
